data_notes: No new persistent entities, tables, or schema changes. This feature is composition-only: it adds a createPolicyService() factory to the policy module that wires PolicyService with its existing concrete collaborators (PgLeavePolicyRepository + LeaveTypeService(PgLeaveTypeRepository)), and changes createBalanceService()/createLeaveService() to call it instead of constructing PolicyService themselves. The two backing repositories already exist and are unchanged; they are recorded here only as the concrete implementations the new factory composes. No new repository interfaces are introduced.
transaction_contract: None — this feature performs no writes and introduces no new data-access paths. It only relocates composition wiring (factory construction). Existing transaction semantics (service-owned IUnitOfWork.withTransaction; repositories accept an optional trailing PoolClient) are unchanged.
